outcome.technical:
Replaced the false sentence 'fileIndex is what the plan gate matches an edit against' with plugins/audit/README.md:461's corrected statement, worded for each file and keeping each paragraph's argument (an unscoped task covers no edit of its own). The corrected statement: the gate matches a running task's `files` and graded `outputs` patterns (hooks/_config.in_progress_task_map reads `files` alone, never a fileIndex row; in_progress_outputs), and fileIndex is derived from `files`, so a row of it alone opens no edit. The dropped 'central guard inert' wording went too. Sites: (1) plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/audit-task.py _locked_scope docstring, 'THE COST WAS NOT TIDINESS' paragraph (~line 10418); (2) plugins/audit/reference/verbs-in-full.md 'And the cost was not tidiness' (~line 1340); (3) PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md scope paragraph (~line 5797). Before finishing, `grep -rn -i 'what the plan gate matches' plugins/audit PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md CONTRIBUTING.md README.md tests tools .claude/hooks` found three FURTHER copies, all in tests/test_audit_task.py (a declared file), and I fixed them: the (sc) block comment (~line 2024), the sc1 title (now: scope re-derives fileIndex from files, and the derived index must carry the same paths or the validator finds shard and index parted; checked against _manifest_crossrefs.py:594-600, the backward fileIndex finding) and the tp3 title (now: the index is a lookup by exact path, per audit-lookup.py:286 'EXACT PATH MATCH ONLY'). Case ids and assertions are unchanged. After the edits the same grep exits 1 (no hits). Left alone on purpose: CHANGELOG.md:4080 carries the same sentence in an already-published changelog entry. That is history, and the file is outside this task's files; I am reporting it here and did not edit it. Also left: the `fileIndex.{0,80}match` grep hits audit-task.py:811, _manifest_phases.py:963, tests/test__manifest_phases.py:209/262 ('a key no path can ever match') and audit-lookup.py:176/286, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md:3437, README.md:1964, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md:6073, commands/layout.md:162, CHANGELOG.md:1593. Each of those describes fileIndex as a lookup or a merge, not as what the gate matches, so they are correct. plugins/audit/commands/init.md:471 was not touched, as the brief ordered. Commands run: `python3 -c 'import ast...' audit-task.py tests/test_audit_task.py` exit 0 (both parse). That is a syntax check, not a gate. No gate was run: executor.runsGate is own-tests and the brief says this task has nothing of its own to run, so the orchestrator's recorded run of tests.gate is the evidence. Dependants: audit-task.py importers (full-gate.py, run-test-gate.py, the test suites) are still correct, because only a docstring changed. verbs-in-full.md path/basename readers (PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, _areas.py, test__areas.py, test__manifest_vocab.py, test_audit_task.py, CHANGELOG.md, agents/guide.md, reference/execute-task.md) are still correct: the file keeps its path, and only body prose inside one section changed. No heading changed. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md basename readers are still correct: no heading or tree line changed. tests/test_audit_task.py dependants (test_commit_task_work.py imports helpers, sweep-costs.json keyed by file/block, tools/affected.py) are still correct: no helper, block or case id changed, only two title strings and a comment.
